## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name follows `feat/<phase>-<name>`, `fix/<name>` or `chore/<name>`
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits, one logical change each
- [ ] New code has tests, and the relevant TC test cases pass
- [ ] `composer quality`, `npm run lint` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Authorization is enforced on the server (policy or role middleware)
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or personal data are committed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated
